title: Staff Product Engineer, AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers to join the AI Group to build Fin's AI-powered products. Product Engineers working in ML work closely with both our ML Scientists and product teams. They must deeply understand our product, our customers, our ML tech stack and our broader product stack. </p> <p>Our group is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.</p> <p>We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated Engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.</p> <p>We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.</p> <p>If you are an experienced product engineer who takes an analytical approach to development and has some hands-on experience with ML systems, we'd love to hear from you! </p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <p>Product Engineers in the AI Group</p> <ul> <li>Build the systems that power Fin's flagship AI products. This usually means working in our ML Python tech stack, but at times also means working across the product on our Rails app too.</li> <li>Work alongside our ML Scientists bring proof-of-concept code to production; ensuring it’s robust and scalable for real-world use.</li> <li>Partner with product teams outside of our group, to shape the best AI-powered product experience for our customers..</li> <li>Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, and implementation and testing.</li> <li>Play an active role in the hiring, mentoring, and career development of other engineers.</li> <li>Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence within the group and across Fin.</li> </ul> <h2>Profile we’re looking for </h2> <p><em>These are meant to be indicative, not hard requirements.</em></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience shipping high-quality products.</li> <li>No ML experience required. We believe you can be highly effective immediately by bringing excellent software engineering skills, and learn ML as you work on the team.</li> <li>You can demonstrate significant impact in the work that you have done.</li> <li>You take pride in having strong technical fundamentals; you love learning and are willing to work hard to invest in your development.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Javascript etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here!</li> <li>Strong willingness to fight for good outcomes</li> <li>Bias towards progress over perfection</li> <li>BSc in Computer Science, Maths or Statistics or related discipline </li> </ul> <h2>Bonus skills & attributes </h2> <ul> <li> <p>Previous experience in data analytics, or statistical role</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You'll sit within our Data Infrastructure team, architecting privacy-preserving systems, leading the implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies across our infrastructure, and providing technical leadership on privacy across engineering, research, and product teams.</p> <p>You'll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, AI safety, and distributed systems, solving problems that don't yet have established answers. title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.</p> <p>In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.</p> <p>Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. A management consulting background is a plus.</li> <li><strong>A track record in sales planning:</strong> quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with data and systems.</strong> You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing incentive models,</strong> variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>A builder and generalist</strong> who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders,</strong> able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.</li> <li><strong>Strong understanding of distinct sales motions,</strong> including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <p>You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Make a visible impact every day,</strong> directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.</li> <li><strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment,</strong> with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Build a career, not just a role,</strong> as DashOS grows across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deliver together</strong> in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description: London, Full time, £140,000–196,000+ Pivotal Research finds people who can work on the biggest risks facing humanity and gets them working on them. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and our programmes have more than doubled in size every year. We had 75 participants in 2026. In 2027 we plan to have at least 180 participants across five cohorts of our AI safety and biodefense fellowships, start at least two new programmes, and grow to at least 16 staff. We are hiring a COO to make sure Pivotal runs well now, still runs well at three times the size, and still runs well when we scale beyond that. You will be responsible for the team that supports execution of our programmes, finances, our systems & processes, and the London office. You will start by managing at least 2 people and build the team from there. You will be the second most senior person at Pivotal and work directly with Tobias Häberli, our CEO, who will focus on strategy, fundraising and new programmes. Why this role matters We think the next few years are unusually important. AGI could bring enormous benefits, and could also cause existential catastrophes. Reducing those risks depends on getting capable people working on the right problems early enough. Since 2024, 135 fellows have participated in our programmes. Alumni have gone on to roles at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI, and GovAI, as well as AI Safety fellowships and internships at Anthropic and OpenAI. We measure our success by the important work our fellows go on to do, and how much Pivotal helped them get there. Right now, our ambition is larger than our capacity to execute well at scale. That is the gap the COO will close, and will help us move from 75 participants in 2026 to at least 180 in 2027. Why work at Pivotal We are a small, mission-driven team at LISA in London. People build what they think should exist, and disagreement with leadership is welcome. Read more on Working at Pivotal (what we have done so far, what working here is like, and reasons this role might not suit you). What you will own You are responsible for the whole of Pivotal outside programme design, research, and fundraising. In practice, that means: Execution. Every programme we run should be excellent. You make sure the infrastructure, systems, and team members supporting each programme work, and you fix what does not. The team. You build and lead the execution team that supports all of our programmes. You decide who we need, make the case for key hires, and run the hiring for your part of the organisation. Early on, Tobias will give input on hires and sign off on final decisions. Scaling. Pivotal needs to grow several times over without becoming worse at what it does. You design how a 16-person organisation runs, and then one that doubles or triples again in the years after. How decisions get made, how money is managed, how new programmes get launched, and how we have operational greatness while we grow. Finance, legal, compliance, systems, and the London office are primarily your responsibility. You will be well-resourced with a team to help you do all of it. Day-to-day leadership in London. Tobias works partly from Switzerland. You are the senior person on the ground, and you make most day-to-day decisions. This frees Tobias to focus on strategy, fundraising, networking, hiring, finding collaborators, and designing new programmes. Who we are looking for The range runs from someone who has already scaled an organisation through rapid growth beyond Pivotal’s current size, to someone who has not done that yet but has a proven track record and shows excellent aptitude for scaling an organisation. Wherever you sit in that range, we want to see some of the following: A record of making things happen. You have taken responsibility for something hard and delivered. People who have worked with you describe you as the person who is on top of things. A record of building and leading a team. You have hired and managed people, set clear expectations, and give direct feedback. You keep teams motivated and supported through rapid growth and intense periods. You build systems. You have improved how a team or organisation works. You can spot where a process will break as demands grow and design systems the team wants to use. You are decisive and high agency. You can prioritise between competing demands, are comfortable deciding with incomplete information, and take ownership of the outcomes. You spot what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked. When something is broken or missing, you take ownership until it’s fixed. You integrate AI well. AI is becoming increasingly important for how Pivotal works. You should have good judgement about where it helps, and where it does not. You make difficult decisions during difficult times. We expect the stakes of our work to only increase, and AI safety work to get a lot more public attention. Strong commitment to the mission. You do not need a background in AI safety, but you should see it as work worth committing a substantial part of your career to. You are honest and direct. Pivotal is small and moves fast. We need someone who tells us when we are wrong. Experience in a fast-growing organisation, a start-up, a scale-up or a similar organisation is a strong plus. What we offer Salary: £140,000–196,000. We can pay more for exceptional candidates. Benefits: Relocation support, a contribution to private health insurance, a personal development budget, childcare support, and an employer pension contribution of at least 5%. Location: London. Hours and start date: Full time. Start as soon as possible, but we’re willing to wait for the right candidate. Visa: We can sponsor a skilled worker visa for this role. Hiring Process We try to respect your time at every step. Written application. A short form about who you are and why this role. Screening interview. 25–30 minutes, personal. Work task (paid). A task that reflects the real job. Personal chat. A conversation with Tobias. Work trial (paid). Two to three days working with us in London (costs covered). You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after. You don't need a CS or STEM degree: technical aptitude can come from your work, side projects or things you've built yourself. description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous models and hardware. The General Capabilities team is developing the science that makes that possible: a principled, evidence-based method for building agentic systems automatically. We are hiring for several positions on this team through one application. Depending on your background, you will work on our agent runtime, on evaluation, or on automated agentic system optimisation. We are looking for experienced systems engineers and researchers. Since we are an interdisciplinary team, we expect depth in one area and a willingness to work across the others. Develop evaluation and observability tooling for long-horizon, tool-using agents. Research methods that improve agents automatically, such as program search, routing, context management, multi-agent collaboration and post-training. Work with our infrastructure teams to optimise agents for cost and latency on heterogeneous hardware. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you’ll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. </p> <h2>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.</li> <li>Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.</li> <li>Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.</li> <li>Help build out DoorDash’s international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.</li> <li>Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.</li> <li>Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.</li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.</li> <li>You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.</li> <li>You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.</li> <li>You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.</li> <li>You’re comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don’t need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.</li> <li>You’re an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).</li> <li>You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.</li> <li>You’re an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems title: Senior Partner Account Manager - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Partner Account Manager - EMEA </strong><br>Location: EMEA (London, in office)<br>Experience: 8–12 years<br>Travel: 50%+<br>Reports To: Director, SI Partnerships<br>Focus: Strategic channel management and geo expansion</p> <p><br>The Sigma Partnerships team is hiring a Senior Partner Account Manager in our London office to support Sigma's continued growth across EMEA. This role will strategically own a portfolio of System Integrator (SI) Partners and will report to GTM leadership within the partner team. This role will drive the growth and success of Sigma across EMEA and collaborate closely with sales and marketing teams to ensure success.</p> <p>Sigma's SI partner ecosystem is growing rapidly, both globally and in the region, to meet rising demand for professional services around Sigma and the Modern Data Stack. The ideal candidate brings a proven track record managing partners, an established network of partner contacts across the EMEA data space, and comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.</p> <p><strong>What you will be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Partner Management:</strong> Design and execute GTM activities for a portfolio of SI partners across EMEA, growing both partner-sourced ACV and services revenue for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Field Alignment: </strong>Work directly with the sales team to coordinate co-selling between partners and Sigma throughout sales cycles, and to recommend partners for services engagements at Sigma customers.</li> <li><strong>Relationship Management:</strong> Build and maintain strong relationships with SI partner executives and employees through regular communication, joint marketing and sales campaigns, and prompt resolution of partner issues and concerns.</li> <li><strong>In-Market Presence: </strong>Represent Sigma at industry events across EMEA to strengthen our brand equity. Partner closely with the Field Marketing team to run events and meet with prospects, customers, and partners to share Sigma’s vision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of partner management experience in enterprise SaaS, or equivalent experience leading at a professional services organization</li> <li>Strong sales instincts and genuine curiosity, always digging deeper to find new ways to partner effectively and differentiate Sigma to generate new opportunities</li> <li>A collaborative team player with a track record of supporting, working with, and winning alongside both internal and external teams</li> <li>Deep experience building executive relationships within partner organizations</li> <li>Genuine interest in the Modern Data Stack and cloud ecosystem</li> <li>Flexible and dynamic, with a builder's mentality suited to a fast-paced, start-up environment</li> <li>Willingness to travel 50%+ within the region, with occasional global travel for events and conferences</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of and experience in the BI/analytics software industry</li> <li>Familiarity with the Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery partner ecosystems</li> <li>Experience standing up reseller partnerships in addition to co-sell motions</li> <li>Experience using Sigma, Salesforce, Crossbeam, and Gong in partner contexts</li> <li>Sales at or professional services/consulting experience, particularly at a Global System Integrator with an established EMEA presence</li> <li>Fluency in English required; additional languages a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us: </strong></p> <p>Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase. </p> <p>Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.</p> <p>Come join us!</p> <h4>Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:</h4> <ul> <li>Equity                                                                                                 </li> <li>Generous health benefits</li> <li>Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!</li> <li>Paid bonding time for all new parents</li> <li>Traditional and Roth 401k</li> <li>Commuter and FSA benefits</li> <li>Lunch Program</li> <li>Dog friendly office</li> </ul> <p>Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.</p> <p><em><strong>Note: </strong>We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.</em></p> <p><strong>Our Privacy Practices</strong></p> <p>When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s <a href="https://www.sigmacomputing.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia). </p> <p><strong>Sigma’s use of AI</strong></p> <p>This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.</p> <p>We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.</p> <p>We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.</p> <p>We work in small, senior teams – so you own real client relationships and real commercial outcomes from day one. We're looking for Senior Managers who want to be the name clients ask for and the market knows. This is a role for people who want to win and deliver work while they build a practice: originating opportunities, leading complex engagements, and growing the reputations – theirs and ours – that open the next door.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise </span></span></h2> <p> </p> <p>Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital Resilience:</strong> helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.</li> <li><strong>Digital Trust: </strong>helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.</p> <p>We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <h3><span title: Senior Manager, AI & Trading Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>As a Senior Manager in our Commodities & Energy Trading practice, you will help clients navigate changing commodity markets by combining trading expertise with the practical application of data, analytics and AI.</p> <p>You will play a key role in shaping and delivering our commodity and energy trading proposition: leading client engagements, developing new opportunities and showing clients where AI and advanced analytics can create genuine commercial value.</p> <p>You are likely to bring deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with some understanding or practical exposure to the other. You will work alongside specialists from both disciplines, building on your core expertise while continuing to deepen your capabilities across the intersection of trading and AI. The aim is to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, measurable improvements in how trading businesses operate.</p> <p><strong>AI & Trading Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape propositions at the intersection of commodity trading, AI and digital transformation, and bring market insight on how AI is changing trading organisations, business models and competitive dynamics</li> <li>Translate real trading problems into practical GenAI and agentic use cases that deliver value to clients</li> <li>Advise clients on where AI should augment human decision-making, where workflows can be automated, and where human judgement remains critical</li> <li>Design trading journeys from opportunity identification and experimentation through to scaled adoption, with the metrics and value cases that show impact on performance, productivity, risk and profitability</li> <li>Work with traders, portfolio managers, data scientists and technology teams to turn concepts into solutions that operate in live trading environments</li> <li>Drive adoption of GenAI copilots, agents and intelligent workflows that improve trader productivity and decision quality</li> <li>Establish governance, model risk, human oversight and responsible-use approaches without losing sight of commercial outcomes</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Commodities & Energy Trading</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Advise on front-to-back trading processes, from market intelligence and trade origination through execution, scheduling, settlement and risk management across commodities including Power, Oil & Refined Products, Natural Gas, LNG, Metals, Renewables and Environmental Products</li> <li>Support clients in evolving their trading strategies, operating models and capabilities in response to changing markets and new technologies</li> <li>Bring an understanding of market structure, pricing, forecasting, physical flows and the commercial decisions that drive trading performance</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span><br><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced professional with 8-12+ years of relevant experience and a strong background in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI. The strongest candidates will combine meaningful experience across both areas. However, we also welcome applicants who bring deep expertise in one discipline alongside a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other.</p> <p>You might be a commodities and trading specialist who has applied data, analytics or AI to trading decisions, processes or transformation, or a data and AI practitioner who has worked in, or gained exposure to, commodities, energy or another trading environment.</p> <p>You do not need equal depth in both disciplines, but you should be able to demonstrate a genuine foundation in each and a clear motivation to deepen your experience at their intersection.</p> <p><strong>What we look for in everyone</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders</li> <li>The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation</li> <li>Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements</li> <li>Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills</li> <li>Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both</li> </ul> <p><strong>If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products</li> <li>A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations</li> <li>Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems</li> <li>Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent automation use cases</li> <li>An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment</li> <li>Some experience of commodities, energy, financial markets or trading environments, with an understanding of how trading organisations make decisions, manage risk and generate value, together with a strong interest in deepening your knowledge of commodity markets and front-to-back trading processes </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><br><span title: Consultant/Senior Consultant, Digital Risk & Cyber
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres – they are where value is won or lost</span></span></h2> <p> </p> <p>The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.</p> <p>We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.</p> <p>We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.</p> <p>We work in small teams of experienced consultants, so everyone has a voice. Quarterly promotion cycles and no quotas mean you are promoted when you are ready, not when a slot opens up.</p> <p>We're looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who want to be known for tackling our clients’ toughest problems in digital risk, security and resilience.</p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Digital Risk and Cyber practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced Consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise</span></span></h2> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:</p> <p>Digital Resilience: helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.</p> <p>Digital Trust: helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.</p> <p>We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.</p> <p>We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.</p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the work:</strong> Take personal ownership of high-quality deliverables on complex engagements – shaping the approach, managing workstreams and making sure what we produce has real impact for the client.</li> <li><strong>Go deep: </strong>Build genuine depth in a specialism you care about, and become the go-to expert colleagues and clients rely on to get the hardest calls right.</li> <li><strong>Solve, don't just advise: </strong>Design frameworks, build operating models and stand up tooling that clients actually use – using AI to compress high-volume work, so your time is spent on the judgement.</li> <li><strong>Be the critical friend: </strong>Advise CISOs and their teams directly across financial services, energy, government and critical national infrastructure – balancing technical depth, commercial understanding and the relationships that make advice land.</li> <li><strong>Help build the business:</strong> Grow your network and profile, contribute to new and evolving propositions, put yourself forward for the right opportunities, and spot ways to create more value for clients.</li> <li><strong>Grow – and grow others:</strong> Own your development, and support and coach the people around you to be at their best. </li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></h3> <p> </p> <p>We care more about the shape of your experience than a checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd love to hear from you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital risk and cyber experience</strong>: a track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, whether gained in consulting or in-house, and a genuine passion for the field.</li> <li><strong>Frameworks and standards:</strong> working knowledge of the standards and frameworks that shape our work, for example NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and the regulatory agenda, for example the EU AI Act, DORA, the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill and CAF.</li> <li><strong>Delivery and client craft:</strong> experience delivering in demanding, client-facing environments (programme or project delivery, risk assessments, governance and assurance), with the communication skills to engage anyone from a technology team to the board.</li> <li><strong>Technology and AI literacy:</strong> fluency in, or real curiosity about, using AI to deliver – compressing high-volume work such as regulatory mapping, evidence review and maturity scoring – and advising clients on securing and governing it.</li> <li><strong>Experience in one or more of our domains:</strong> meaningful experience in at least one area we operate in, particularly: OT/ICS security, CAF, AI security and governance, post-quantum and cryptographic agility, operational resilience, strategy and operating model, supply chain risk, security architecture, crisis management and DevSecOps.<span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":200,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: title: Proctor Quality and Learning Manager, Scaling Operations
description: <p>Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!</p> <p>At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.</p> <p>Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. </p> <p>Read <a href="https://blog.duolingo.com/?utm_source=greenhouse.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=generalblog_gh_091224">our blog</a> to learn more.</p> <hr> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>About the role...</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;">The Duolingo English Test (DET) is a high-stakes assessment used by institutions around the world. Its integrity depends on proctors making accurate, consistent, and defensible decisions — even when sessions present ambiguous evidence or new forms of cheating. As the Proctor Quality and Learning Manager (L3) in Scaling Operations, you will own the end-to-end quality standard and learning system that keep our global proctor network aligned and effective as security threats, technology, and workflows evolve. You’ll define what “correct” looks like, run our calibration and adjudication program, and build ongoing training that measurably improves decision quality. You will partner with Psychometrics, Security, Operations, Product, and Engineering to ensure our human and AI-assisted workflows meet rigorous accuracy standards before and after deployment. This is an individual-contributor role within DET Proctoring Operations, with functional leadership over Training Specialists and adjudicators executing the program.</p> <p><strong>🧠  You will...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the DET proctoring quality standard — maintain rubrics, decision rules, examples, and guidance that define accurate decisions across routine and difficult edge cases.</li> <li>Lead calibration and adjudication — operate recurring Proctor Certification Test cycles, resolve disputed decisions, identify patterns of disagreement, and ensure outcomes are consistent and auditable.</li> <li>Build and run an ongoing learning program — publish a forward-looking training calendar, deliver monthly interventions, and launch targeted training in response to quality signals, threats, or workflow changes.</li> <li>Measure effectiveness — use calibration results, audits, and performance trends to identify learning needs, evaluate training impact, and decide when to clarify standards, retrain, or update guidance.</li> <li>Guide specialist execution — set expectations for Training Specialists and adjudicators, assign deliverables, review outputs, and operate onboarding and certification that ramp new specialists quickly.</li> <li>Maintain durable sources of truth — keep calibration, adjudication, and training runbooks current so critical processes are documented and auditable.</li> <li>Evolve quality alongside proctoring — translate new threats and workflow changes into clear standards, training, and quality controls in partnership with Psychometrics, Security, Operations, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Represent the proctoring craft — bring frontline proctor evidence into product experiments and workflow decisions; assess whether launched changes preserve decision quality.</li> <li>Connect human and technology-assisted quality — establish benchmarks for AI-assisted workflows and validate automated capabilities against real sessions before deployment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>✅  You have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in assessment development, scoring/rater quality, certification, quality assurance, or a field involving complex, consequential judgments; experience aligning reviewers to a shared standard through calibration programs.</li> <li>Adult-learning program experience spanning onboarding, certification, ongoing training, remediation, and effectiveness measurement (beyond one-off materials).</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and strong judgment in ambiguous cases; ability to produce clear, defensible decisions and guidance.</li> <li>Analytical fluency to interpret quality data, disagreement patterns, and performance trends and translate them into practical interventions.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; ability to turn complex standards into precise, usable guidance and explain difficult calls.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership without formal authority; experience directing contractors or partners toward clear accountability and outcomes.</li> <li>Demonstrated skill in quality standards and rubric design, building living systems with decision logs, change histories, and controls for auditability.</li> <li>Experience defining quality benchmarks and validation methods for human–technology workflows, including AI-assisted processes.</li> <li>Adaptability — comfort revising standards and programs as risks, products, and technology change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in language assessment, test security, remote proctoring, trust and safety, or fraud prevention in high-integrity environments.</li> <li>Experience maintaining quality across large, distributed examiner/rater/reviewer/contractor populations.</li> <li>Familiarity with assessment concepts such as inter-rater agreement, reliability, standardization, and performance monitoring.</li> <li>Experience designing quality systems that span human judgment and technology-assisted workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with learning-management systems, assessment platforms, quality-audit tools, or operational analytics.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!</em></p></div><div class="title">Salary Range: </div><div class="pay-range"><span>£90,630</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£122,617 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="Z7ph2"><strong>Benefits:</strong> Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits <a href="https://careers.duolingo.com/#benefits">here</a>.<br><br><strong>Job Alerts:</strong> Sign up for job alerts <a href="http://my.greenhouse.io/users/sign_in?job_board=duolingo">here</a>.<br><br><strong>Accommodations: </strong>We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team. Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months. If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you. What you’ll do: Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>THE POSITION</strong></p> <p>Our roster has an opening with your name on it</p> <p>Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to shape the technical direction of the systems behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain.</p> <p>CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it.</p> <p>The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle <em>Everything Begins with the Customer.</em></p> <p>That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in seconds, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role, at the same level as our Software Engineering Directors. You will own the technical strategy for a major part of CPE over a multi-year horizon, working alongside Directors and senior Product partners to work out what we build and what we stop. You will take on the questions with no obviously correct answer: where a capability belongs, which systems to retire, how money moves safely across providers, how to prove compliance without slowing delivery. A lot of this will not have been done here before, so a large part of the work is finding out what is true before the organisation commits to it.</p> <p>You are close to the code in your day-to-day, but most of your impact comes through other engineers: shaping designs, working the hardest incidents with the people closest to them, and growing the engineers moving into Staff and Senior Staff roles. You can trace a fan’s experience back through the stack to the decision that caused it, and you can explain a technical trade-off to an executive audience without diluting it.</p> <p>You are candid about what is not working, you seek out views that differ from your own, and when a call needs making you make it and help others get behind it, <em>Challenge and Commit.</em> You wear your FanDuel hat first and do not restrict yourself to organisational boundaries, <em>We are One Team.</em> You are a visible part of the domain leadership team and of our senior engineering community, and a role model to the wider engineering organisation, <em>Humble and Hungry.</em></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>THE GAME PLAN</strong><br>Everyone on our team has a part to play</p> <ul> <li>Own the long-term technical strategy for your area of CPE, aligning the architecture of several teams with wider FanDuel initiatives and with the scale the business is heading towards.</li> <li>Start from the customer outcome and work back: registration and verification completion, time to first bet, deposit and withdrawal success rates, payout speed, geolocation pass rates, and the availability of whole journeys rather than the uptime of single services. Make sure our systems can measure these, and create new ways to measure and communicate customer impact where today’s fall short.</li> <li>Make the technical choices that have sweeping consequences across the domain, design the systems they call for in stages rather than as a single large bet, and bring engineers, managers and product partners with you.</li> <li>Architect for extreme, event-driven peak load and for third-party failure, so that capacity, failover and degradation behaviour are proven before the biggest days in the sporting calendar, and an outage at a payment, KYC or geolocation supplier does not reach customers.</li> <li>Treat regulation as an engineering requirement, building in auditability, evidence, data boundaries and jurisdictional variation from the start, and hold responsible gaming and player integrity systems to the same standard as any revenue-generating feature.</li> <li>Raise the operational bar across your area. Get hands-on with the most complex incidents, find the root cause, make sure corrective actions remove the class of failure rather than the instance, and support our software as part of an on-call rotation.</li> <li>Simplify the estate. Retire duplicated capability and unnecessary coupling, make considered build-versus-buy choices, and recognise waste in tooling, infrastructure, vendor services and payment processing costs.</li> <li>Set the standard for how AI is used across the software lifecycle in CPE, including where we choose not to use it, with evidence of the effect on throughput, quality and security and the judgement to tell real uplift from theatre.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations early to shape scope and trade-offs, spot the opportunities CPE’s capabilities open up, and help refocus work that is off course or not making a difference for customers.</li> <li>Coach and mentor engineers, particularly those growing into Staff and Senior Staff roles, spread knowledge through design reviews, talks and written documentation, and take part in hiring senior engineers and managers.</li> <li>Work with Principal Engineers and the wider senior engineering community to shape FanDuel-wide standards for architecture, tooling and engineering practice, and model a culture of quality, candour and collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>THE STATS</strong></p> <p>What we’re looking for in our next teammate</p> <p>You don’t need all of these to apply, but they all count</p> <ul> <li>Several years as a Staff-level or more senior individual contributor, setting technical direction across multiple teams and bringing them with you through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>A track record of designing and running high-volume transactional systems in payments, financial services, identity or another regulated domain, with a deep grasp of the patterns that keep money and state correct, such as idempotency, High volume. You’ve worked at a company where the volume of data or transactions shaped how you designed systems. Migrations. You’ve moved live systems and data onto a new platform with zero downtime. Python. You’ve used Python in production, with a web framework such as Django, FastAPI, or Flask. You’ve built asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, such as Kafka. The salary We expect to pay from £100,000 to £120,000 for this role. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
